entries.zh: 主管；掌管；执掌（事务、权柄）
entries.en: to govern; to manage; to be in charge of

to hold under one's authority; to command and subordinate

entries.zh: 共同管理；合管；一起经管
entries.en: to manage jointly; to govern together

entries.zh: 掌权；执掌权柄；行使管辖权
entries.en: to hold power; to exercise jurisdiction
entries.notes: 「合權」非常见词，依 L jurisdicción 与 M hap-kuân 定为执掌权柄、行使管辖权。

entries.zh: 对针；按罗盘针定向（行船）
entries.en: to set a course by the compass needle; to steer by the needle
entries.notes: L aguia 当为 aguja（罗盘针），据 H 對針 及 navio 语境释为按针定向。

great king; ruler; governor (honorific)

entries.zh: 治天下；统治世间（天下之主）
entries.en: to govern the world; ruler of all under heaven
the middle realm; the air (its governor)
the lower realm; the earth (its governor)

entries.zh: 三界（天、中、下三界）；统辖万物的主宰
entries.en: the three realms; governor of all creation
entries.notes: L 疑为「de todo lo criado」，R 栏注释残缺，释义主要据 H 三界 与 M sam-kài。

entries.zh: 土王；本地之王；土著首领
entries.en: local king; native chief; governor of the Indians

entries.en: rank; title of nobility; dignity and office
